CustomField.description: The type string exactly as the external system sent it, before normalisation. Never public: it is absent from every guest DTO and from Portfolio_HQ_Guest, because whatever someone types into Asana would otherwise become a public string - "Reading: Negotiating After a Layoff" is a real leak, and one nobody would notice, because Type__c is not a field anyone thinks of as free text. Its purpose is evidence: SELECT Source_Type__c, COUNT(Id) FROM Work_Item__c WHERE Type__c = 'Unspecified' GROUP BY Source_Type__c turns "which types am I actually using" into a query rather than a hunch, and a raw value that shows up often enough earns a place in the restricted picklist.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: What the external system called this item's type, before mapping. Internal only - never shown to public visitors.
CustomField.label: Source Type
